themes.label: Fed Regime Change — Warsh Hiking Leg Confirmed; Bear-Flattening Intact but Stalling
themes.stance: Bear-flattening thesis confirmed but momentum stalling: 2Y slipped to 4.67% from 4.74% (still well above 4.50% hiking-leg threshold); 10Y ticked back under 5.00% to 4.94%; 10Y-2Y spread unchanged at ~0.27. Spread is pricing sticky inflation/fiscal term premium, not cuts. ZROZ UW remains highest-conviction duration call. Sep 29-30 FOMC is the next guidance read; 10Y-3M (0.87) is firmly positive — inflation-premium curve, not recession signal.
themes.tell: 2Y holding >4.50% confirms hiking-leg risk (press UW); break below 4.10% revives cut trade (cover duration UW). Sep 29-30 FOMC hawkish guidance = press further; dovish tilt or hold signal = reassess leg thesis. Aug core PCE (Sep 30) ≥+0.3% MoM = reinforce duration UW.

themes.label: Core Inflation Trajectory — Services Sticky; Oil Passthrough Still Ahead
themes.stance: Core CPI +0.29% MoM (Aug), headline +0.40% (~4.8% annualized) — domestic services-driven, not oil-dependent. WTI rolling back confirms 'oil down = Fed pivots' reflex should be faded. M2 at 23.2T (~+5% annualized) offers no disinflationary offset. Core PCE ran +0.24% MoM in July; Aug PCE (Sep 30) is the deciding print. Oil passthrough impulse is still ahead. TIPZ and IAU remain cleanest expressions.
themes.tell: Aug core PCE (Sep 30) ≥+0.3% MoM = services/oil passthrough arriving, extend inflation longs and press duration UW; ≤+0.2% = tactical fade signal. Sept CPI (Oct 14 area) ≥+0.3% = full passthrough confirmed. Two consecutive sub-0.2% prints = thesis inflects lower.

themes.label: BoJ Rate Hike — Japanese Capital Repatriation Draining UST Demand
themes.stance: BoJ hike to 31-year high continues to make JGBs attractive and drain marginal UST demand into the Nov 5 Treasury refunding. Putin's reignition of the Japan disputed-islands dispute adds a JPY/carry wildcard on top of the BoJ-hike backdrop. Repatriation amplifies bear-flattening and term-premium independently of US fiscal dynamics. Yen-supportive; carry-unwind risk elevated.
themes.tell: 10Y sustained >5.00% with soft 30Y auction (tail >1bp) = repatriation/demand-drain confirmed, press duration UW. 10Y back below 4.80% with strong auction demand = repatriation fear overdone, reassess. USDJPY breaking below ~140 with MOVE/VIX spike = carry unwind underway, cut equity beta fast.

themes.label: Dual Choke Point Oil Shock — Supply De-escalating; Geopolitical Floor Thinning
themes.stance: Supply side de-escalating faster than rhetoric: Hormuz throughput hit a six-month high, WTI well off the $107 Sep-15 peak and confirmed pulling back. Iran vowing 'painful' retaliation into UNGA week is noise against the supply reality. Geopolitical floor is thinning, not gone — no confirmed dual-front ceasefire. Trim acute tactical oil beta; retain structural XLE/refiner sleeve as inflation hedge. Oil relief does not flip inflation or duration thesis.
themes.tell: Brent sustained below $85 with confirmed dual-front de-escalation (Hormuz AND Red Sea tanker-routing data) = trim to structural sleeve only. WTI back above $100 on fresh supply disruption = re-press energy. Early-Oct OPEC+ supply increase = supply-side cap confirms pullback, not spike.

themes.label: Arsenal Depletion — Multi-Year Defense Restocking Mandate
themes.stance: Intact and broadening. Multi-theatre depletion: Iran strikes, Russia probing NATO airspace (Poland/Tusk), Houthi strikes on Saudi facilities. Dem House near-locked (91.5%) — demand is secular, funding timing is the only risk. Sep 30 FY27 fiscal year-end is potential supplemental vehicle. OW XAR, LMT, RTX, NOC.
themes.tell: Sep 30 defense supplemental introduced or passed = restocking thesis funded near-term. Prime contractor (LMT, RTX, NOC) order-book guidance raised on late-Oct earnings = demand confirmed. Simultaneous binding ceasefire across Iran/Hormuz, Ukraine, AND Red Sea = trim acute premium; multi-year thesis survives on global broadening.

themes.label: AI Trade Bifurcating — Cost-of-Capital + IPO Supply Wall; Sentiment Turning Mainstream
themes.stance: 5% cost-of-capital compresses long-duration AI multiples mechanically; OpenAI IPO supply wall (>$500B, ~99% probability per prediction market) is an unpriced overhang. Sentiment shift confirmed: mainstream 'how to protect your 401k from the AI crash' pieces now circulating (Bloomberg). This is an early-warning signal, not yet a break. Barbell tightens: hold margin-defended moats (MSFT, AMZN), cut vendor-financed/dilution-funded names. Decider anchors confirmed: FOMC Nov 4-5 and CPI Oct (Nov 10); NVDA earnings pending desk date confirmation.
themes.tell: 10Y sustained >5.00% = long-duration AI multiple compression accelerates, trim capex cohort harder. MSFT Oct 22: capex raised + gross margins intact = moat holds; margin warnings or capex guidance cuts = confirm de-rating, press short leg. OpenAI IPO pricing ≥$1T = cohort multiple re-rating risk fully active. NVDA earnings miss/guide-down = cohort de-rating confirmed.

themes.label: Yen Carry Unwind Vol Tail — BoJ Hike + Geopolitical Wildcard Elevates Risk
themes.stance: BoJ hike to 31-year high is a direct carry-cost shock. Putin's reignition of Japan's disputed-islands dispute adds a fresh geopolitical JPY wildcard. Soft broad USD (~118) and global bond selloff keep carry-unwind tail acute. A disorderly unwind remains a stocks-and-bonds-down-together event. Soft dollar is net positive for gold and oil-exporter EM (EWZ/Petrobras). USDJPY not in today's inputs — level must be watched directly.
themes.tell: USDJPY breaking below ~140 with concurrent MOVE/VIX spike = carry unwind underway, cut equity beta fast. USDJPY stabilizing above 145 with vol contained = hedge can be trimmed. Broad USD index sustained above 119 = soft-dollar EM condition breaks, revisit EWZ/EEM positioning.

themes.label: Consumer Squeeze — One-Month Real Rebound; Call Softened, Not Resolved
themes.stance: Aug retail +1.24% MoM nominal beat CPI (+0.40%) for a clean real-positive (~+0.84% real), rebutting July's real-negative print. Michigan recovering to 55.2 (July) vs 44.8 May low. Resilient consumer removes near-term recession release valve and hands Fed cover to stay restrictive. Hold discretionary UW pending second consecutive real-positive (Sept retail, ~mid-Oct). Homebuilders UW stays clean: starts fell to 1,275k (Aug); 5%-adjacent mortgage rates do independent damage.
themes.tell: Sept retail (real, ~Oct 16): second consecutive real-positive = resolve squeeze thesis, cover discretionary UW. Real-negative reversal = squeeze reasserts, deepen UW. Oct 2 Sept payrolls weak with real-negative retail = recession-release-valve risk revives.
